title: BI Business Analyst
text: BI Business Analyst at Perspective Recruitment (Melbourne, Bayside & South Eastern Suburbs; Contract/Temp; salary: not stated). Working for an industry leader, you will and co-ordinate complex requirements and be the conduit between business users and technical teams. Play an important role in the ICT Business Intelligence team, working with the business, other BA’s and developers to deliver BI and reporting solutions to the business. The Business Analyst may also contribute in other business system areas as required in relation to data quality and or establishing new data sources. Duties include: Work with sponsors, vendors and SME to analyse, define and document business and functional requirement Build strong relationships between multiple technical and business teams Schedule and drive design workshops, liaising with SMEs, developers and vendor representatives to ensure all requirements are understood and addressed Scope, planning and delivery of BI and Information project Participate in conversations around BI technical delivery and system design Assist in allocation of technical resources across project Where requirements conflict across business areas provide a forum whereby conflicts can be resolved Review design deliverables to ensure match to requirements and optimum design for usability and efficiency Assist in identifying business process changes and ensuring new processes are documented and communicate Participate in the development of the test scenarios and test cases and execution(if required) Provide input into the business process / user documentation and training materials Liaise with developers and vendor representatives to determine status of tasks, providing this information to the Project Manager for executive reporting Ensure that issues raised within the project are identified and resolved in a timely manner Ensure compliance to the Change Management process ensuring use of correct templates for deliverables, appropriate reviews, conducting regular stakeholder meetings and, adequate testing of changes Requirements: Must have an IT background, whether this be by qualification or through demonstrated experience of requirements gathering AND functional design of IT systems Strong working experience with Business Intelligence systems and Data Warehouse projects as a Business Analyst Conceptual knowledge of Data Warehouse, ETL and BI Systems Excellent Business Analyst skills across project scoping, planning, execution and on-going support Willingness to take full responsibility for defining requirements end to end across a broad range of business areas Ability to conduct detailed analysis of complex requirements and data Ability to assess solution proposals Ability to identify key risk areas and prioritise analysis tasks accordingly Excellent skills in requirements gathering, documentation and translation to other forms of project documentation (such as functional specifications or test scripts) in various formats suitable for intended audiences (e.g. sponsors, architects, developers and vendors) Excellent vendor liaison skills as well as an ability to elicit cooperation from stakeholders, colleagues and management Experienced in user acceptance testing and end to end testing Excellent communication skills Experience developing Power BI or similar reporting or analytical tool is highly desirable Experience with Kepion or similar Corporate Performance Management tool would be well regarded This is truly a great opportunity to join an exciting project and work with a fantastic brand and team.
